name: Ollama Cloud
description: Ollama Cloud — OpenAI-compatible inference API for cloud models (GLM-5.1, Kimi K2.5, Qwen3, Gemma4, etc.)
author: Streamliner One

skill.useWhen: ollama cloud, use ollama, run glm, glm-5.1, ollama model, ollama inference, run cloud model via ollama, ollama api
skill.note: Base URL: https://ollama.com/v1 (NOT api.ollama.com — that 301s). Auth: Bearer API key. No :cloud suffix on model names (e.g. glm-5.1, not glm-5.1:cloud). Pro plan ($20/mo) required for cloud inference.

defaultModel.label: Default Cloud Model
defaultModel.help: Cloud model to use by default. No :cloud suffix needed.

validation.successMessage: Connected to Ollama Cloud — GLM-5.1 responding ✓

errorMessages.301: Wrong base URL — should be ollama.com/v1 not api.ollama.com
errorMessages.403: Key lacks permissions or Pro plan not active
errorMessages.429: Rate limited — session limit reached (resets every 5h)

usage.title: Ollama Cloud — chat completion
usage.summary: OpenAI-compatible endpoint at https://ollama.com/v1. Auth: Bearer API key. No :cloud suffix on model names.
params: model (string, required — e.g. glm-5.1, kimi-k2.5, qwen3)
usage.commonError: 301 if using api.ollama.com — correct base is ollama.com/v1; 401 invalid key; 429 session limit (resets every 5h)
